text:
Hi friends,
I'm looking into organizing a 60hr course in English in Tel Aviv  for people that would like to volunteer at Mada (Magen David Adom) -- Israel's national ambulance and emergency service 🚑 

Are there other people in the group (or not in the group) that might be interested in such a course?

The course will give you the first basic knowledge to assist people in medical emergencies on and off the ambulance 🩺

If I'm not mistaken, those that commit to volunteer at Mada for a certain amount of hours, will be able to participate in the course for free, but I'm still waiting for an official answer about this. 

So if you want to gain life saving skills; help people in distress; integrate with other locals and improve your Hebrew while doing it; and give back to Israeli society in a meaningful way, please let me know in the comments 🙏

I hope this post isn't against the group rules and main subject.
